facts.text: The resort is on Grace Bay Road in Providenciales, Turks and Caicos Islands.
facts.excerpt: Grace Bay Road, Providenciales, Turks and Caicos Islands, TKCA 1ZZ

facts.text: The suites are situated on Grace Bay Beach.
facts.excerpt: Situated on Grace Bay Beach, our suites offer maximum luxury and comfort

facts.text: BLT Steak is the resort's steakhouse.
facts.excerpt: BLT Steak is our Turks and Caicos steakhouse.

facts.text: Casa Nonna is the resort's Italian restaurant, serving traditional Italian cuisine from fresh, local and seasonal ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Our Italian restaurant in Turks and Caicos serves traditional Italian cuisine from fresh, local and seasonal ingredients.

facts.text: Coralli is a seaside restaurant where local ingredients meet Mediterranean flavors.
facts.excerpt: Coralli is our seaside dining option where local ingredients meet Mediterranean flavors.

facts.text: Noori is a Japanese restaurant and bar.
facts.excerpt: Our skilled mixologists craft delicious and fresh cocktails with a Turks and Caicos twist at our Japanese restaurant and bar.

facts.text: Ritual Coffee Culture serves illy coffee.
facts.excerpt: Discover an elevated coffee experience featuring expertly brewed illy selections in a modern, inviting setting.

facts.text: The resort has an adults-only pool and a family pool.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our two outdoor resort pools including an adults-only pool and an interactive family pool.

facts.text: Private cabanas are available at the adults-only pool.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your pool experience by enjoying shaded private cabanas at the adults-only pool

facts.text: The resort has its own luxury sailing catamaran, Lady Grace, which sails Grace Bay.
facts.excerpt: Embark on an extraordinary voyage aboard Lady Grace, the signature luxury catamaran of The Ritz-Carlton, Turks & Caicos. Gracefully sailing the turquoise waters of Grace Bay

facts.text: The Ritz Kids club is for children ages 4 to 12.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz Kids at The Ritz-Carlton, Turks and Caicos is dedicated to introducing young guests ages 4-12 to the history and natural wonders of Turks and Caicos

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the 9th floor and has ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the 9th floor, Club Level guests are invited to enjoy stunning ocean views in a comfortable lounge.

facts.text: The spa has a hair salon, sauna and whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: Our Turks and Caicos Spa offers a Hair Salon, Sauna, Whirlpool, and treatments for relaxation and rejuvenation.

facts.text: The resort has a casino with slot machines and table games.
facts.excerpt: luxury resort casino in Providenciales with the latest in slot machines and table games

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Access to the Club Lounge requires an upgraded booking.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club.

facts.text: Breakfast is available onsite at Coralli and Ritual Coffee Culture for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Coralli and Ritual Coffee Culture for a fee.
